fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-08-19, an investment offer shared in a messaging group led the complainant to deposit Rs. 4,50,000, after which contact ended. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-08-12 at roughly 10:35. The online submission was made by Karthik Pandian (9000000137). Ramya Bai was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100048, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Ajith Nathan, using the number 9000000297.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scheme reportedly promoted through a messaging group.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, mobile number, witness, residential colony, bank account, transaction record, suspect
